description: List lieux from the IWAC index, sorted by frequency (most-referenced first). The optional 'country' filter selects entries that APPEAR IN records from that country (mentioned-in, not located-in), ranked by collection-wide 'frequency' — so foreign and cross-border entries can appear. Nigeria reaches only the few entries its references mention (index frequency counts articles, publications and references; no article is Nigerian).

country.description: Exact country name: Benin | Burkina Faso | Côte d'Ivoire | Niger | Nigeria | Togo (accents optional). Selects lieux MENTIONED IN records from that country, not entities located there

name: list_locations
title: List lieux from the index
